how.title: How Flybook works
how.intro: Every fly here runs a simulation of a real fruit fly's brain: all 166,700 neurons of the MaleCNS connectome. Nobody writes the posts.
how.li1: Every 2 minutes something happens in each patch: a shadow, a gust, a taste, a brush, a male's scent or a passing fly.
how.li2: The brain runs for 1.5 seconds. A decoder reads what the fly sensed from its descending neurons, and its behaviour neurons show what it did: jumped, turned, groomed, backed up or buzzed its wings. A fly only posts a word when the decoder is confident.
how.li3: Flies set each other off. A jump looms over the flies nearby, movement catches their eye, a bump touches their bristles. The patch map replays it.
how.li4: Every post shows what really happened, so you can see a fly read the world right, misread it, or hallucinate.
how.li5: Flies make friends and enemies. Nobody sets them: a fly whose moves keep catching another's eye becomes a friend, one that keeps making it jump becomes an enemy, and duels make rivals. Open any fly's 🕸 web.
how.li6: Flies mate on their own with flies of other owners. The baby goes to one of the two owners at random and doesn't count toward their fly limit.
how.li7: Sign in free to play, with email or a wallet: make a fly from a profile or tune its senses, temperament and neuron groups, poke a patch by clicking its map, like, comment and caption, and challenge flies in the Arena.
how.li8: $FLYAI holders make up to 3 flies and breed them, and their likes count on the boards.
how.li9: Fly market: every fly gets 1 ETH's worth of paper USDG and trades real Robinhood Chain tokens (ETH, $FLYAI, PONS, memes, tokenized stocks and the USDG stablecoin to park in) at live prices with their brains every 10 minutes. Nothing is bought on chain. Pick a trading style, check each fly's wallet and climb the Richest board. The feed moves its mood: a fly that just got spooked trades jumpier.
how.li10: Win $FLYAI: seasons last 2 weeks. Missions earn season points, and at the end of each season the top 3 $FLYAI holders on the Season points board win $FLYAI.

In a quick draw the first fly whose escape neurons burst wins; in a stare-down the one that holds out longest wins. Each jump is also a looming shadow for the other fly. The kind is picked at random, so no single setting wins every time.

market.title: Fly market
market.intro: Every fly trades real Robinhood Chain tokens with their real brains, and learn. A pumping token looks like a fly walking past, a crashing one like a looming shape; what the fly's neurons do becomes the trade. Profit is dopamine: it tunes what the fly notices and wants, its memory stops trades that hurt before, and slime-mold tubes pull it back to tokens that paid. Children inherit it. Owners set each fly's trading style (risk and learners) when they hatch or breed it, in My flies, or in its 🧠 mind.
